book.name: 1 Korin
book.title: Pol To Metengei Naha Korin Sios Leni Rumbwero Chengi

content: Ani Pol, ani Jisas Kurais tau ra himache. Gotri ri okokona naha ki Jisas Kurais tau ra himache hinga ri ani esiro. Ani ga ai hiparakambwe ri, Sositenis, ga sindo do chengi si kaini

Korin ko ki dau Gotri ri sios hima leni, kunu, si humbwendau. Kurais Jisas kapwa sumbu kuhi rani ri humbwewani hima kipe naha ku sirasiwani, rihi minde naha hinga kunu ri ondiyasindau. Kunu ga ele ko ele ko ki dau sembe ha hima lenga tinda ete, nui Apukolaka Jisas Kurais hi ni wu uchandau hima leni rihi minde wunu ri nasindau. Rini wunu ga nunu ga funda nui Apukolaka.
Nui Yapai Gotri ga nui Apukolaka, Jisas Kurais, ga kunu keke fi woni sembe wahapi ti o kunu fi hakonda.
Pol Gotri ni weseꞌaro
Jisas Kurais kunu wosiro sumbu kekembwa Gotri ri hima keke wo sumbu ti omwesika kunu haro. Woro o keke gisi gisi kunu ani hambwandani Gotri ni a weseꞌandau.

Kurais mwanji ti kunu nu sawero ti, kunu o tini sembe we kuhi ki kwambu naha ki ku toronambusindau. O sumbu keke Gotri ele sumbu kipe hinga tinda ete o ai kunu yandoꞌi yandotasinda, Gotri mwanji bwandau sumbu kuhi le, e, hambwa kipe hambwandau sumbu kuhi le okwe.
O keke apa Gotri Himamwale haro peresen foti keke ku heifunda nambwe ku dani nui Apukolaka, Jisas Kurais, amwei ri sirano tini ku nikisindau.

Woro o Apukolaka to kunu okulasiwa kwambu tiki ku etisini ete ku da dawa gisi jipe kuhi ti o ete ini humbukonda. Wosiwa apa nui Apukolaka, Jisas Kurais, hima ni koti wono gisi tawa, nunu kapwa sumbu nambwe huruhumba hinga hinde nunu hei kumbwa.

Gotri do sumbu ni mwe naha ri wosikondau. Hinde wowani, rini mwanji mwe naha kumbwa ri bwani sumbu mwe ya ri wosinda. Do Gotri tombwa Kurais, nui Apukolaka, ga sembe funda ku da kinani kunu ri ucharo.
Sios ti huwani nerimbe miyafo apumbwa apu iro

Woro ai hiparakambwe le, nui Apukolaka, Jisas Kurais, hi ki mwanji kwambu tiki ka hinga kunu a sawenda: Kunu tinda ete mwanji funda kumbwa ma ku bwani ku sirina. Apa kunjenga kui nindo ki apumbwa apu ku huwa kei. Kunu nerimbe funda naha kumbwa ma ku etisini sembe funda ku owesini inaka funda kumbwa ma ku hambwa.
Ai hiparakambwe le, Kulowi ri hima kupu le kui nindo ki ku anangiyandau mwanji leni wu ani sawero.

Woro wui mwanji a mendiwani kunu funda funda tinda ete ka hinga ku sawendau: Kunu fwele sawe, “Ani Pol himache,” wowani fwele sawe, “Ani Apolos himache,” ete wowani fwele sawe, “Ani Pita himache,” wowani fwele sawe, “Ani Kurais himache.”

Woro hinde hinga ku hambwandau? Ka Kurais alase ki fikasini apumbwa apu iroꞌo? Ani Pol to ka me yapweke ki ani hasini kunu ani okularoꞌo? Ka uku ku yaro ti, hi ahi, Pol, ni sembe ku hasini uku ku yaroꞌo?
Kui nindo ki Kurisupas hima pi Gaiyas numbwa uku a yasiro, hima fwele mina. Woro o keke Gotri ni a weseꞌanda.
O keke apa hima fori ete sawe hinga, kunu hi ahi ki uku ku yaro.
O mwe naha, Sitefanas hima kupu le okwe wunu a yasiro. Wosini hima foringa ai a yasiro umo? Mina, opito.

Kurais ani humbwero ti, hima leni uku a yasi ki ri ani humbwe nambwe, mina. Ani ri ani humbwero ti, Gotri mwanji kipe a bwa ki ri ani humbwero. Woro Gotri mwanji kipe a bwano ti, do nuwe kipe hambwa ki a torosini a bwa hinga, mina, foki Kurais me yapweke ki ri haro ti, bwelefo kalefo hinga wu nano.
Kurais rini Gotri kwambu

Mwe naha, hi tiki raikondau hima le me yapweke mwanji tini wu mendini ambwatinambwati mwanji hinga wu hambwakonda. Woro nunu Gotri ai nunu rataro himiyama hurahama leto nu hambwanda, me yapweke mwanji ti, o Gotri kwambu.
Hinde wowani, Gotri chengi ete sawero,

content.text: “Hambwa laka hambwandau hima lei wui hambwa ti walambe wunu a wosisindau.
Wondani mwaringamwe kipe naha hambwandau hima lei mwaringamwe ti, a rani a humbwe sindau.”

content: Kale hambwa laka hambwandau hima le, soki wu dau? Kale Moses kaisiro Gotri lo mwanji ondiyakandiyandau hima le, soki wu dau? Do nuwe ki dau mwanji bwa hima naha le, soki wu dau? Gotri do nuwe ki dau ele hambwa wuhi, e, mwaringamwe wuhi hinga ri wosiwani ri miyaningisopo ki ambwatinambwati hima hinga wu sirasindau.

Do nuwe ki dau hima le, wui hambwa ki, Gotri hambwa ti hinde apa wu hambwa kumbwa. O sumbu hinga wunu ki sukwasindau ti, ri inaka ki funda ri hambwafwaꞌaisindau. Woro, o keke, Gotri ele himiyama hurahama ni ai ri ratano numbo foti okokona rihi ki ri nambusinda. Ri namburo numbo mwe ti ka: Do nuwe kipe hima le Gotri mwanji kipe ni ambwatinambwati mwaꞌambwe hinga wu naro, woro o mwanji numbwa wu mendini sembe wu hawambwa Gotri wunu ri ai ratakonda.
Juta hima kupu le Gotri ni sembe wu ha kinani Gotri sumbu kwambu keke wu uchandawani, Girik hima leto Gotri ni wu wakinehei kinani hambwa omwesika wu toro ki au wunu saindau.

Woro, nunu, Kurais me yapweke ki haro mwanji tini nu bwandau. Woro o mwanji to Juta hima kupu lei sembe ti walambe wunu ikoni wunu etipendawani, Girik himako to o mwanji ni wu mendikoni ambwatinambwati mwanji hinga wu nandau.

Woro nunu, Juta hima kupu fweleꞌe, Girik hima fwele, Gotri nunu uchawani ri tumwa ti nu mendiro hima le, ka hinga mwe naha nu hambwandau, Kurais rini Gotri kwambu hingambwa naha ri dasini rini Gotri hambwandau hingambwa naha ri hambwandau.

Do me yapweke mwanji Gotri nunu haro ti, do nuwe kipe hima le ambwatinambwati mwanji hinga wu hambwandau ti, ele wui hambwa ni dikisindau. E, me yapweke mwanji wu mendini Gotri ni kwambu nambwe wu nandau ti, rini kwambu chele, ele wui kwambu ni ri dikisindau.

Ai hiparakambwe le, kunu imbihumbwa Gotri kunu uchawani ku tani sembe ku haro tini ma ku hambwa. Kui nindo ki, hima miyafo do nuwe kipe hambwa ni miyafo wu toro nambwe, hima miyafo hima apukolaka hinga wu eti nambwe, e, hima miyafo hi chele hima hinga wu da nambwe.

Woro Gotri do nuwe ki dau hambwanda nambwe hima leni uchani rihi wunu ri naro ti, do nuwe kipe hambwa laka hambwandau hima leto huruhumba wu hei kinani. Gotri do nuwe ki hima apukolaka eti nambwe hima leni ri uchani rihi wunu ri naro ti, do nuwe ki dau kwambu chele hima leto huruhumba wu hei kinani.

E, Gotri do nuwe ki dau hi nambwe hima le, e, tikisapu wu nandau hima le wunu ni ri uchani rihi wunu ri naro. Mwe naha, Gotri do nuwe kipe hi nambwe, kwambu nambwe, e, mwaꞌambwe nambwe hima leni rihi wunu ri naro ti, hi ga dau, kwambu ga dau, e, mwaꞌambwe ga dau do nuwe kipe hima leto huruhumba wu hei kinani.
O sumbu hinga ri wosiro ti, foki apa hima fori Gotri miyaningisopo ki rinjenga hi rihi tini ri rasai ki.

Woro kunu Gotri kunu esisiwani Kurais Jisas ga funda ku dau. Kurais Jisas Gotri okokona tini sirinani do nuwe ki ele tau rihi ri rani ri humburo ti keke apa Gotri hambwa kipe tini nunu ri handani hima kipe naha nu sirano numbo rihi ti nunu ri mekundau. Rindombwa nunu ri okulawambwa kipe naha tumbwa nu ichiꞌuchandano. Rindombwa ri hasini ri fi ki nui kapwa sumbu keke wungwa ri jisini ai nunu ri ratandau.
O keke Gotri ri okokona ti, ri chengi ki sawero ka mwanji hingambwa ma nu wosi, “Hima fori hima foi hi tini ri rasai kinawa, rini Apukolaka i hi numbwa sa ri rasai.”
